# Cyberdrone tracks leads, deals, and quotes for its drone shows in Zoho CRM

No customer quote is in the source. None is added here.

## The company

Cyberdrone is an entertainment drone company in the United Arab Emirates. It provides drone-based solutions for live events, film production, and promotions. It runs a growing fleet of drones, and its projects bring together several teams, including overseas shows. The source does not give a founding year, a headcount, or fleet numbers.

## The challenge

The sales side ran on manual work. Leads came in from the website, email, and phone calls, and they were logged by hand in separate tools or not logged at all. Follow-ups were missed and opportunities were lost. The sales team had no single view of the pipeline, so deals were tracked inconsistently and revenue was hard to forecast. Quotes and proposals were not always accurate, because they did not account for which drones were free or when the team was available.

Customer history was not in one place, so sales reps missed details and their follow-ups looked unprofessional. Without data on past projects, upselling chances were missed.

### Operations behind the sales

The same manual approach affected the work behind the quotes. The company kept drone specifications, assignments, and usage in spreadsheets, so an unavailable drone could be assigned to a project, and maintenance could be missed. Events and film shoots were planned without templates or defined task dependencies, which caused bottlenecks.

## The solution

Cyberdrone adopted Zoho One. Its team works mainly in Zoho CRM, Zoho Creator, Zoho Projects, and Zoho Books, and Zoho CRM is tailored to the company's sales process.

### Leads that arrive and get assigned

Zoho CRM captures leads automatically from web enquiries, email, and social media. Leads are grouped by industry for targeted communication, and tasks are assigned by team availability and skill.

### A pipeline with a follow-up at each stage

Deals move through custom stages: enquiry, proposal, negotiation, and contract. Zoho CRM sends an email follow-up at each stage.

### Quotes that reflect drone availability

A fleet app in Zoho Creator holds each drone's specifications, status, and current assignment. Zoho CRM pulls drone availability from Zoho Creator, so a project quote starts from the fleet the company has free.

### What managers see

Dashboards in Zoho CRM show revenue forecasts and sales performance. Dashboards in Zoho Creator show fleet status, down to the individual drone.

## Benefits

Leads from every channel land in one system and follow-up tasks are assigned automatically. Each deal moves through the same stages, and quotes use real drone availability. Fleet, project, and sales data connect, and the company is set up to grow. The source gives no figure for any of this.

## Partner engagement

Nurture Spark Digital carried out the transformation across the company's departments, with the aim of keeping each department's data connected and accurate. The source does not give the project length.

# LFT FIT brings online, in-store, and B2B customers into one view in Zoho CRM

No customer quote is in the source. None is added here.

## The company

LFT FIT is a South African e-commerce and retail business that sells premium gym wear locally and internationally. It sells through an online store, a point-of-sale system, and a B2B channel for custom clothing orders. It has been trading for three years. It runs every part of the business itself except order fulfilment and delivery, which third-party logistics providers handle. The source does not give a headcount.

## The challenge

LFT FIT had no central place for customer information. Details came in from several sources and sat in separate software that did not talk to each other, so each customer's journey was split across tools. The business wanted one platform and one view of every customer for sales, marketing, support, and reporting.

The business set three requirements:

- A no-code system that the team could run without scripting, so it can grow.
- Native features only, with no paid third-party extensions, to keep cost down.
- The same functions the team already relied on, such as Omnisend, rebuilt in Zoho Marketing Automation.

### How the project started

The project opened with a workshop that mapped the business processes, systems, stakeholders, customer journeys, and reporting needs. From that, the project team drew up a design showing how data moves between the Zoho apps and the existing non-Zoho systems. The whole project took three months, with a week of solution design.

## The solution

LFT FIT works from Zoho One. Zoho CRM holds the B2B customers and gives every team one customer view. It receives B2C customers, products, and orders from Shopify, which runs both the online store and the point of sale.

### One record for each customer

Shopify sends customer, product, and order data to Zoho CRM and Zoho Marketing Automation. Zoho CRM passes data on to the other Zoho apps the business uses. B2B leads come in through Zoho Forms and are created in Zoho CRM when a form is completed.

### Support and marketing on the same customer

Zoho Desk is the single place for support queries from WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, email, and the Contact Us form. Tickets are pushed to the customer in Zoho CRM and to Zoho Social. Zoho Marketing Automation runs journeys for abandoned carts and purchase follow-ups for Shopify and CRM customers and writes campaign data back to the customer in Zoho CRM.

### Social, projects, and reporting

Zoho Social shows how each social channel is performing and manages posts, and sends engagement data to Zoho CRM and Zoho Desk. Zoho Projects plans internal projects and events, and Zoho Expense tracks employee expenses and project costs. Zoho Analytics reports across all of the apps.

## Benefits

Customer data that was scattered is now in one connected system. Sales, marketing, and support work from the same customer record across every channel the customer uses. The source says the project paid back through streamlined operations, and describes the solution as iterative and scalable. It gives no figure.

## Partner engagement

Both& Digital Transformation is the partner on the Find a Partner record for this story. The source describes the work as a workshop, a design of the full set of apps, an implementation, and training. It gives the project length as three months, with one week of solution design.

# Stanstead Immigration manages visa clients and leads in Zoho CRM

No customer quote is in the source. None is added here.

## The company

Stanstead Immigration is a Canadian company that handles study visas, visitor visas, business programs, family sponsorship, general immigration, and U.S. immigration. Its team guides individuals and families through the application process. The source does not say when the company was founded, how many people work there, or where in Canada it is based.

## The challenge

As demand grew, Stanstead's manual processes stopped keeping up. Client information and visa applications were handled on paper and by hand, which took time and raised the risk of data entry errors. The source does not name a previous system.

Visa files need identification papers, financial records, and supporting documents. Tracking them by hand caused delays, and papers could be misplaced or lost. Consultations, document submissions, and follow-ups were hard to schedule, so appointments clashed and follow-ups were missed. The team also needed to answer website visitors in real time, because a fast reply is what turns a visitor into a client.

## The solution

Stanstead's team works from Zoho CRM as part of Zoho One. Each client has one record that everyone on the team can open.

### Client records and follow-ups

Zoho CRM holds all client information in one place. Automated follow-ups make sure no client is overlooked, and the team can see where each visa application stands, so clients get updates without delay.

### Leads that are sorted for the team

Zoho CRM categorises and prioritises incoming leads. Workflows and reminders make follow-ups happen on a schedule, and the team spends its time on the clients most likely to sign.

### Intake, agreements, and signatures

Zoho Forms collects client details through online forms that write straight into Zoho CRM, so nobody retypes them. Clients sign documents electronically in Zoho Sign from anywhere in the world. Zoho Contracts creates, approves, and tracks client agreements and sends reminders before they renew.

### Appointments and website chat

Zoho Bookings schedules consultations, and clients can submit documents when it suits them. Zoho SalesIQ puts a live chat on the website, tracks what visitors do, and sends the lead to the right team member.

### Billing and documents

Zoho Books issues invoices and records online payments. Zoho WorkDrive stores client documents, and permissions limit each file to authorised staff.

## Benefits

Automating data entry, document handling, and follow-ups cuts the time each application takes. The team processes visa applications more quickly and handles more clients. Documents sit in one place, so fewer files go missing. Live chat and automated lead handling in Zoho SalesIQ and Zoho CRM raise the rate at which leads become clients. The source gives no figure for any of these.

"My firm uses Zoho CRM every day. When a new potential client contacts us through the web form, the details get automatically saved in the CRM, and from there we can convert the lead into customer, set follow up tasks, schedule meetings and much more. With the help of the customized CRM and web form, we can now keep track of, and follow up with everyone who reaches out to us, so that nobody falls through the cracks."
Penn Dodson, Attorney, Firm Owner, AndersonDodson P.C.

## The company

AndersonDodson, P.C. is a workers' rights law firm in New York City. It recovers wages for employees who are unpaid or underpaid. Its clients are individuals, and two people at the firm use the CRM. The source does not give a founding year or a headcount.

## The challenge

AndersonDodson takes a client on only after a strict qualification process. The intake has several steps, and the firm has to keep accurate records and documents at each one. As the firm's reputation grew, so did the number of leads and clients, and keeping those records by hand took a large share of the team's time.

The firm looked for a simple, easy-to-manage CRM that was scalable and cost effective. After trying a few products it chose Zoho CRM. The source does not name those products or say what the firm used before them. Dodson wanted to tailor the CRM to the firm's intake process, but neither she nor her partner had the time or the expertise, so the firm looked for an implementation partner.

The website's Contact Us form was a second gap. It collected contact details and a callback request, but it could not tell a prospective client from a general query or a press enquiry.

## The solution

AndersonDodson's team works from a customised Zoho CRM, set up for the firm's intake process.

### Enquiries that arrive sorted

The Contact Us form now has fields where a visitor states why they are getting in touch. The details go straight into Zoho CRM and are sorted into categories as they arrive, so the team knows who to contact and why. From the record, the team converts a lead, sets follow-up tasks, and schedules meetings.

### Campaigns tied to the record

Zoho Campaigns is connected to Zoho CRM and runs the firm's drip campaigns. When an email campaign goes out, Zoho CRM creates follow-up tasks automatically. The setup stops duplicate campaigns and duplicate contacts.

## Benefits

Every person who reaches the firm through the web form lands in Zoho CRM, sorted by what they want. Leads become clients, follow-up tasks, and meetings from the same record, and the firm keeps track of everyone who reaches out. The source gives no figure for time saved.

# Khaitan Schools bring admissions enquiries from every channel into Zoho CRM

## Key results:
- Lead conversion improvement 35%
- Reduction in manual tasks 40%

## The company

The Khaitan School was established in 1995. The source names two branches, Khaitan World School and Khaitan Public School. The school has more than 3,600 students, more than 200 staff, and an alumni network of more than 1,400. The Khaitan family of Ramgarh, Rajasthan, has a long history in education, and the school carries that on.

## The challenge

Admissions enquiries reached the school through the website, Facebook, and admission forms. The team could not capture and track them reliably, and could not follow up with prospective students and their families quickly. Website data from the two schools was mixed together, so the team could not analyse each school's leads separately. Without task tracking, it was unclear which enquiries were genuine, what stage each was at, and when to close it.

Finance had its own manual step. Each month, someone copied cost-centre data from Google Sheets by hand, which was slow and error-prone. The source does not name the system the school used for leads before.

The school set five aims for the new system:

- Track student enquiries and admission forms.
- Improve communication with prospective students and parents.
- Keep the status of each admission up to date.
- Recognise repeat students and families.
- Answer student questions around the clock.

## The solution

The school's admissions team works from Zoho CRM, which holds every enquiry in one place.

### Enquiries from every channel in one place

The website is connected to Zoho CRM, so each admission form shows where it came from and which school is generating more leads. A tool called Lead Chains brings Facebook leads into Zoho CRM automatically. Zoho Forms supplies admission forms that parents open by QR code or link, and each submission goes straight into the CRM. Zoho CRM groups the leads from all these sources and automates follow-ups.

### Follow-up by WhatsApp and email

A connection with Pinnacle lets the team send WhatsApp messages from the CRM and give each family a unique enquiry ID. It also schedules follow-up notifications by WhatsApp and email.

### Finance data without copy and paste

A Tally connector, built as a desktop application with React and TDL XML, exports cost-centre data from both schools to a Google Sheet in a fixed format. Power BI dashboards read from that sheet.

### Social media

Zoho Social lets the team schedule posts to the school's Facebook account, sync published content, and see performance reports.

## Benefits and ROI

Enquiries from the website, Facebook, and forms land in Zoho CRM and the team follows up faster. Zoho CRM and Zoho Forms handle data entry and follow-up reminders, which the source credits with a 40% reduction in manual tasks, and lead conversion improved by 35%. The school's finance team gets cost-centre data in a consistent format for its dashboards.

## Partner engagement

Extension ERP is the partner on the Find a Partner record for this story. The source describes the work in the first person plural and does not name the partner. It covers the CRM setup, the connection to Lead Chains, Pinnacle, and Tally, and the desktop connector built with React and TDL XML. It does not give the project length.

# Rheonik Americas moves its quotation matrix from Excel to Zoho Creator and Zoho CRM

## The company

Rheonik makes custom Coriolis mass flow meters for specialised fuel measurement. Rheonik Americas Inc is the customer named on the directory record, in the United States. The quoting tool covers three products, Sensor, Transmitter, and Documentation, and builds each quote with a matrix method. The source does not say where in the US the company is, how large it is, or how many people use the CRM.

## The challenge

Quotes began as a full matrix in Microsoft Excel, with detailed calculations to set up. Once the Excel quote was ready, someone had to rebuild the final version in the CRM by copying and pasting. That took time, invited errors, and made corrections expensive. The finished quote was exported as a PDF, emailed to the client, and stored for later.

Creating work by hand also made it harder to track where it came from and how it was used.

## The solution

Rheonik's quoting now runs in a custom app built on Zoho Creator and connected to Zoho CRM.

### From matrix to form

The Excel matrix became a set of flows in Zoho Creator. A user fills in a form with the quote details. On submission, the app generates the quote as a PDF that can be downloaded with one click. Prices, including discounts and adjustments, are calculated when the PDF is produced.

### Quotes in the CRM without retyping

The quote data is pushed to Zoho CRM when the quote is created, so nobody copies it across. Staff create quotes after talking to the customer by phone or email, and the quote syncs to Zoho CRM for the record. Customers can also create their own quotes in the app.

### Deals and contacts together

The app links deals to contacts and sends notifications through workflows, so users see each deal alongside the people involved.

## Benefits

Automation reduces the manual errors that came from rebuilding quotes by hand. Staff produce accurate quotes more quickly, and customers can do the same. The source gives no figure for time saved or errors avoided.

## Partner engagement

AgaramSoft Technologies built the quoting app on Zoho Creator and connected it to Zoho CRM and the Zoho One suite. The source does not give the project length.
